declaration: HRESULT ValidateDevice( DWORD* pNumPasses);

evidence.detail: declaration, requirements block, parameter list read mechanically from the page

parameters.description: Pointer to a DWORD value to fill with the number of rendering passes needed to complete the desired effect through multipass rendering. Some drivers will break down complex texture cascades into multiple passes. In these cases, *pNumPasses will contain the number of passes. Other drivers will fail texture cascades that they cannot render in one pass. In these cases, * pNumPasses will always be 1 for any supported texture cascade.
parameters.name: pNumPasses
